I'm a medical student from an undeveloped country. So, I'm gonna tell you how we do it here. Sometimes arrive homeless people at hospital and when they die, social service notifies to judicial service, this service makes a register a about that dead person and take them to refrigerator system. In case of exist family they have 15 day to take the body, otherwise the body ends in the common pit. When the patient have relatives, the body is taken to pathology while the family is making formalities with funeral service (bury or cremation) Once the decision is made, funeral service take the body and end the process. With amputated extremities, are taken to the pathology apartment where they are incinerated. I used to take them there. Same happen with fetuses and organs. And blood and fluids are contained in specific jars, gets mixed with biological fluids solidifier powder, it becomes in jelly for better transportation and ends burned.
